cited.quote: A new ITI will be set up in Neyveli in partnership with NLC

rationale: C1 is a budget speech announcing a new ITI at Neyveli (statement of intent, not a GO or sanction). C2-C5 concern ITI upgrades, industrial parks and MSME/business rules, not new ITIs. No official step for new ITIs in industrial cities.

No extract concerns persuading the railways to issue a no-objection certificate. C2 is a plan and estimate charge remittance for a road over bridge; C3-C4 concern fibre-net right of way; C1 and C5 are unrelated.

cited.quote: Oduvar Archaka training schools will be revived to create a trained pool of Oduvar and Archakas

rationale: C2 covers temple administration and priest training, but no extract shows a monthly allowance of Rs.2000 for priests registered with a welfare board. C1 and C3 are differently-abled maintenance allowances; C4-C5 unrelated.

cited.quote: Releasing Tamil Nadu’s Industrial Development Strategy for a five year period
the State Government has proposed to come up with a Sustainable Mining Policy for the State

rationale: C1 lists a planned industrial development strategy and C3 says a sustainable mining policy is proposed; both are plans in policy notes, not an issued policy. C5 is an MSME revival committee, not a natural-resource-based diversified growth policy.

cited.quote: The focus of industrial policy will be on the further diversification of the industrial base of Tamil Nadu
Constitution of Committee for Revival of MSMEs in Tamil Nadu

rationale: C3 states diversification as a policy focus (intent). C4 constitutes an advisory committee for MSME revival, a related step but not an institutional mechanism to execute a diversified industrial growth policy. C1-C2 describe existing bodies and plans.

cited.quote: taking up the issue of retrieval of Katchatheevu with the Government of India

rationale: C1 (Governor's Address) states the intent to take up Katchatheevu retrieval with the Union; no extract shows a formal step such as a resolution, letter or GO. Directional commitment with mention only: not started. C2-C5 unrelated.
No extract concerns railway privatisation or any state opposition to it. C1 and C3 are other Governor's Address passages, C2 lockdown rules, C4 a DISHA committee, C5 crop insurance.
No extract concerns a cooking gas cylinder subsidy for ration card holders. C1 and C3 cover Covid cash relief and grocery kits, C2 an RTI subject list, C4 ration supply, C5 minimum wages.

cited.quote: This Government will ensure that all the incomplete houses are taken up and completed at the earliest.

rationale: C4 is a budget speech pledging completion of incomplete rural houses (intent, no GO or sanction). C1-C2 are audit findings on an idle Samathuvapuram; C3 and C5 unrelated. No official step to complete partially built houses.
No extract concerns upgrading the listed towns to municipal corporations. C1-C2 are urban works scheme guidelines, C3 allocation of ministerial business, C4-C5 flood restoration road works.

cited.quote: The Government will take various efforts in the current year to protect the welfare of Coconut farmers.
Rugose Spiralling Whitefly in Coconut trees, Integrated Pest Management practices will be carried out

rationale: C1-C2 (agriculture budget speech) announce coconut productivity and pest-management schemes, not monetary compensation for drought or mite losses. C4 is wildlife-damage compensation; C3/C5 coconut-peeling wages. No official compensation step.

No extract concerns refurbishing house buildings over 15 years old. C1 is house building advance for employees, C2 incomplete rural houses, C3 urban projects, C4 urban works guidelines, C5 an audit of a community hall.

No extract concerns a regulatory committee of local government, police, traders/vendors and residents' associations. C1 is a real estate authority appointment, C2/C5 Covid orphan committees, C3 bonded labour, C4 a tourism revival committee.

cited.quote: Skill training programmes across Government departments will be better integrated through the Tamil Nadu Skill Development Corporation.

rationale: C3 and C4 deal with skill training through the existing Skill Development Corporation; C2 continues an MSME skill scheme. None creates a new State Board of Skill Training and Employment Promotion (STEP).

cited.quote: The Post Matric Scholarship scheme is the flagship scheme for the educational advancement of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes

rationale: C3 and C2 concern SC/ST scholarship schemes generally; C1 audits a scholarship. No extract extends a scholarship to children of inter-caste marriages with Adi Dravidar or Scheduled Tribe persons.

cited.quote: Special attention is paid to the welfare of transgender persons.
The total provision for the Tamil Nadu Slum Clearance Board in the Revised Budget Estimates

rationale: C2 covers transgender pensions and cash assistance; C1 gives the Slum Clearance Board's budget. Neither shows allotment of houses to transgender persons through the Board. C3-C5 unrelated.

No extract concerns a discount (rebate) subsidy. C3 releases MSME capital subsidy, C1 lists service timelines, C2 audits farm-machinery subsidy misuse, C4 orphan relief, C5 crop insurance premium subsidy; none is the promised subsidy.

No extract concerns creating youth self-empowerment groups of 15 persons. C1 covers ICTACT activities, C2/C4 agricultural youth schemes, C3/C5 urban employment scheme guidelines with worker groups of 5-10.
